retrievalProfile.description: A warm, sepia-toned studio portrait featuring a male subject in formal attire with elegant, right-aligned serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A waist-up studio portrait of a man with a curly hairstyle and mustache, wearing a dark tuxedo with a high-collared white shirt. The image uses a warm, monochromatic sepia palette with soft, diffused lighting that creates a gentle glow on the skin and a textured, painterly background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame
Typography is anchored in the upper right quadrant
High-contrast white shirt collar acts as a central focal point
Soft-focus background texture mirrors the subject's hair texture
coreInvariants: Warm sepia or monochromatic brown color grading
Soft, diffused studio lighting with minimal harsh shadows
Formal attire including a tuxedo and pocket square
Direct eye contact with a slight smile

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale bust portrait, slightly off-center to the left, filling most of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright white of the upturned shirt collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the bright collar, then follows the gaze toward the text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Textured background on the right side provides breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep chocolate browns and umber in the suit and hair.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Creamy whites in the shirt and pocket square.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm tan and sepia mid-tones in the skin and background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on tonal gradation and value contrast between the dark suit and light shirt.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical serif with moderate stroke contrast
letterConstructionRules: Standard upright for the primary name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and styles (upright vs italic) of the same serif family.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule separating name from title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the classic, elegant feel of the era's soul records.
Provides the necessary weight and traditional serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm sepia studio portrait of a man in a tuxedo against a textured brown backdrop, leaving the upper right quadrant clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned serif text in the upper right using an off-white color with a very subtle drop shadow for legibility.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly sepia/brown?
Is the lighting soft and diffused?
Is the subject wearing a tuxedo with a white collar?

recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Sepia Grade + Right-Aligned Serif Typography = Classic Soul Aesthetic
